messages:
maya: heads-up — launch posts went out at 09:00 PST and we saw +1.2k landing page visits, but the dashboard shows only +8 MQLs. anyone else seeing the gap? :thinking:

oliver: saw the spike in events. first thought is UTM mismatch or our inbound routing dropping medium=organic. did the launch template change utm_medium?

maya: i used the usual template but swapped the campaign param to campaign=launch_v3. utm_medium=post (we've used 'social' historically). not sure if the campaign script maps 'post' to any channel routing.

leo: dashboard pulseboard -> conversion funnel shows webinar signups down ~40% relative to visits for that cohort. looks like source attribution for the landing form is falling back to direct.

sophia: @data-bot can you run a quick reconciliation? compare raw pageviews with inbound lead rows for that landing slug and that hour window.

data-bot: daily-sync completed. last sync 4799999010. starting ad-hoc reconcile...

nora: quick check — our form handler logic only reads utm_source and utm_campaign if utm_medium not in ["email","paid"], otherwise it defaults to channel="direct". if utm_medium='post' it might be treated as unknown.

oliver: that explains it. so visits attributed but form hits fallback to direct because 'post' isn't whitelisted. we should add 'post' to mapping.

maya: adding 'post' now to the form mapping. small deploy. will post PR.

leo: after mapping change, can we reprocess the last 6 hours for the launch slug? need the numbers corrected before Monday KPI review.

data-bot: reprocess job queued by nora. preview SQL used: 
```sql
SELECT count(1) as leads, utm_medium, utm_source, created_hour
FROM inbound_leads_raw
WHERE path = '/launch-2026' AND created_at >= '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY utm_medium, utm_source, created_hour
ORDER BY created_hour;
```

nora: queued. ETA ~8m for job to finish on the nightly cluster.

sophia: also, let's update the KPI board to show 'attribution reprocessed' note so weekly kpi reviewers know counts were backfilled.

maya: PR: github.com/redwood/marketing/utm-mapping/pull/42 — adds 'post' -> channel 'social'. deploying now :shipit:

data-bot: reprocess complete. preview: 1,012 leads attributed to utm_medium='post', utm_source='launch_v3'. backfill will apply in ~15m.

oliver: great. can someone add a short blurb for Monday 10am KPI readout: "launch_v3 post channel initially fell back to direct due to utm_medium mapping; reprocessed +1,012 leads, dashboard updated"

nora: i'll draft & post to the kpi channel and update the pulseboard note.

leo: thanks team. quick win. also recommend we add a validation check to the deploy template so unknown utm_medium values warn at push time.

sophia: agree — flagging as a dev-ex improvement in the backlog.

maya: thanks all. will monitor post-backfill metrics and confirm before Monday.
